text:
Nina (CSM): quick raw notes from this morning's onboarding with LatticePay — captured a few product asks + a clear renewal hinge (renewal ~60d). dropping unedited thread here.
Avery (PM): send pls — want to understand what we can do quick vs long-term.
Nina (CSM): call snippets: 
- Request 1: 'show cost per API route and model in Console' — they're multiple internal services pointing at our API and need team-level attribution to justify higher commit. said they'd upsell if they can show cost breakdown per feature.
- Request 2: 'incremental embedding refresh API' — their indexer currently re-embeds entire DB nightly; want delta-only re-embed + webhook trigger for changed keys to reduce cost spikes and staleness.
- Request 3: 'client-side backpressure + retry hooks' — high QPS ingestion, losing batches when transient rejects happen; need an SDK-level primitive to pause/retry without buffering on their infra.
Also: customer explicitly said renewal will be delayed without clear cost predictability.
Ravi (Eng): technical take: Request 1 needs telemetry tags (route_id + model_id) from runtime and slight Console filtering (infra + UI). medium effort.
Ravi (Eng): Request 2 requires new embedding API + small changes to our indexer; more work, infra coord.
Ravi (Eng): Request 3 likely SDK changes (JS/Python) + small runtime signal to return a lightweight retry code. low-ish effort.
Avery (PM): can we RICE these quickly? we need a prioritization for renewals team.
Nina (CSM): RICE-lite bullets: 
- R1 (per-route costs): Reach = high (all customers with multi-service), Impact = high (unlock committed spend), Confidence = med, Effort = med -> score ~ 60
- R2 (embed delta API): Reach = med, Impact = high (cost reduction), Confidence = med-low, Effort = high -> score ~ 42
- R3 (SDK backpressure): Reach = med, Impact = med, Confidence = high, Effort = low -> score ~ 56
Avery (PM): ordering looks like R1 then R3 then R2. but note R1 needs infra tagging which could take 2 sprints. is there a stopgap?
Ravi (Eng): stopgap: add SDK tagging (customer can set route_id on client) + Console filter to show tagged events. doable in ~1 sprint as a short-circuit. full infra tagging + billing export is ~2 sprints.
Nina (CSM): recommended launch plan for renewals: 
- Stopgap (1 sprint): SDK route_tag + Console filter + renewal one-pager with customer quote.
- Mid-term (2 sprints): runtime telemetry tags + billing export and automated per-route reports.
- Long-term: embed delta API + webhook after mid-term telemetry is live.
Avery (PM): I will allocate a small slice for the stopgap if it helps renewals. Ravi, can you prototype SDK tag patches?
Ravi (Eng): yes — can prototype JS + Python clients in ~4 days; runtime changes not required for stopgap.
Nina (CSM): I've raised tickets: CS-8011 (stopgap tags), CS-8012 (embed-delta). CS Bot: ticket created CS-8011 in triage.
CS Bot: Automated note: CS-8011 created by Nina; status=triage.
Avery (PM): next steps: Nina to produce 1-page for renewals folder, Ravi to prototype client patch, Avery to confirm capacity for stopgap within 48-72h. follow-up in 72h. :thumbsup:
Nina (CSM): tagging the renewal owner and adding link to the one-pager when it's uploaded.
Avery (PM): @renewals-team flagged — LatticePay renewal contingent on cost visibility; recommend short-term SDK tagging plan.
Nina (CSM): end — will update thread with one-pager link.
